joint_selection_resolution.unknown_or_mismatch_rule: UNKNOWN, MEASUREMENT_MISMATCH or NOT_DIAGNOSTIC in either central discriminator yields that claim's NOT_DIAGNOSTIC verdict and therefore a joint NOT_DIAGNOSTIC result.
joint_selection_resolution.economic_identity: D3 tests whether the consolidated issuer recovered a material annual portion of the six-plant capital loss in recurring operating contribution; D4 tests whether the same economic improvement reached owner cash after stripping positive working-capital release. Neither can substitute for the other.
prohibited_aggregation: D1 closure continuation or D2 volume and mix as a substitute for D3 or D4
optional product throughput inferred from D2 sales volume
D5 continuous capital recovery as a binary selection hit
security price, investment return or portfolio outcome

simple_baseline_resolution.interpretation_limit: The baseline loss vector evaluates only the two frozen FY2015 point forecasts. It cannot create or reverse the D3+D4 joint selection verdict, become a probability or method win, or use a fabricated point forecast for H-A or H-B.

diagnostic_only_claims.reason: Closure implementation or reversal diagnoses whether the action persisted but does not decide recurring contribution or owner cash.
Sales volume and realized revenue per headline kilolitre provide customer and mix context but are explicitly non-voting.
Three-year capital recovery remains a continuous permanent-loss reading without a frozen binary threshold.

status_preservation.rule: UNKNOWN, MEASUREMENT_MISMATCH and NOT_DIAGNOSTIC remain explicit; no missing issuer-perimeter input may be imputed from sales volume, net profit, group survival, security price or another claim.

outcome_firewall_attestation.attestation: This amendment was authored only from the final frozen R-104 cutoff packet and its accepted independent pre-outcome review. No post-cutoff title, filename, snippet, report existence, body, value or result was enumerated, opened or inferred.
